WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
                     WHEN 1 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                     WHEN 2 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                     WHEN 3 THEN CAST(0 AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(-1 AS BIGINT) END AS value,
               CASE id WHEN 3 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 4 THEN CAST(63 AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(1 AS BIGINT) END AS distance
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, value >>> distance AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS value FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, shiftrightunsigned(value, 1) AS result FROM operands

SELECT id, shiftrightunsigned(i, -1) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8

WITH operands AS (

                     WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-2147483647' AS INT) ELSE p END AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, value >>> 1 AS result FROM operands
